title: What's New in Cloth NeXt 2.4.10
subtitle: Simple installation presence, with silent background requests.

highlights.title: Superhive Username
highlights.description: Enter your Superhive username in Preferences or the first-run prompt. Cloth NeXt accepts your claimed username without checking accounts or purchases.

highlights.title: Background Presence
highlights.description: A periodic HTTPS request sends your configured username, random Installation ID, version, and release channel. The server sees the source IP. Network failures remain silent and do not restrict Cloth NeXt.

highlights.title: Documented Data Collection
highlights.description: Presence collection is described in the privacy documentation. No credentials, hardware fingerprint, purchaser list, or scene data is sent.
